boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Ohio University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food and market stops with published 2026–27 late availability on or near Ohio University’s Athens campus.

cards.title: Earl's Coop on East Green
cards.subtitle: Shively Hall, East Green • open to midnight Monday–Thursday
cards.notes: Use the Shively Hall counter for chicken tenders, waffle fries, macaroni and cheese, or a vegetarian alternative before its published midnight close.
cards.short_summary: A campus chicken-tender counter with the board’s latest food-service close.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University lists Earl's Coop in Shively Hall and publishes Monday–Thursday lunch and dinner hours of 11:00 a.m.–midnight for 2026–27.
cards.source_title: Ohio University Culinary Services: Locations and Hours
cards.access_notes: Published 2026–27 hours: Monday–Thursday, 11:00 a.m.–midnight; the page notes it is closed for summer 2026.

cards.title: Maggie Davis Market Express
cards.subtitle: Baker University Center • open 6 a.m.–2 a.m. daily
cards.notes: Head to the Baker Center ground floor for self-checkout snacks, drinks, ready-made meals, essentials, and Ohio University gear until 2 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A daily, on-campus self-checkout market open into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University identifies Maggie Davis Market Express in Baker University Center and lists daily 2026–27 hours of 6:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Ohio University Culinary Services: Locations and Hours
cards.access_notes: Published 2026–27 hours: Monday–Sunday, 6:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m.

cards.title: Courtside Pizza
cards.subtitle: Athens • open until 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s live online-ordering page before going; it lists pizza, wings, and Friday and Saturday service through 2 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A direct-order pizza stop with published 2 a.m. weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Courtside Pizza’s direct online-ordering page lists Friday and Saturday hours of 11:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Courtside Pizza Athens: Online Ordering
cards.access_notes: Published ordering hours include Friday and Saturday, 11:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m.; confirm availability on the ordering page before leaving.

cards.title: Shively Commons
cards.subtitle: 59 East Green Drive • open until 10:30 p.m. most days
cards.notes: Use the East Green commons for lunch or dinner during its listed evening window; check the calendar because break and holiday closures are posted.
cards.short_summary: An East Green dining location with service scheduled through 10:30 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University lists Shively Commons at 59 East Green Drive and publishes 2026–27 closing times of 10:30 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday.
cards.source_title: Ohio University Culinary Services: Locations and Hours
cards.access_notes: Published 2026–27 hours: Monday–Thursday 10:30 a.m.–10:30 p.m.; Sunday 5:00–10:30 p.m.; Friday ends at 4 p.m.

cards.title: The Hungry Cat Food Truck
cards.subtitle: Top of Morton Hill • open until 10 p.m. Monday–Thursday
cards.notes: Find the university food truck near Morton Hill for American favorites with Southwestern and Asian influences; mobile ordering is available through OHIO Eats.
cards.short_summary: A named campus food truck scheduled until 10 p.m. on weekdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University says The Hungry Cat is usually at the top of Morton Hill and lists 2026–27 Monday–Thursday hours of 11:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Ohio University Culinary Services: Locations and Hours
cards.access_notes: Published 2026–27 hours: Monday–Thursday, 11:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.; closed Saturday and Sunday. Location can vary on campus.

cards.entity_name: Brick City Deli On The Go
cards.title: Brick City Deli On The Go
cards.subtitle: In front of Lindley Hall, South Court Street • until 10 p.m.
cards.notes: Order a made-to-order deli sandwich at the food truck in front of Lindley Hall; use OHIO Eats ahead of a weekday evening visit.
cards.short_summary: A South Court Street food truck with weekday service through 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University places Brick City Deli On The Go in front of Lindley Hall on South Court Street and lists Monday–Thursday hours of 11:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Ohio University Culinary Services: Locations and Hours
cards.access_notes: Published 2026–27 hours: Monday–Thursday, 11:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.; closed Saturday and Sunday. Food-truck service may be weather-sensitive.

cards.title: Jefferson Marketplace
cards.subtitle: Jefferson Hall, 46 East Green Drive • open until 10 p.m.
cards.notes: Use the East Green marketplace for its market selection or stop by Brick City Deli before its listed 10 p.m. Monday–Thursday close.
cards.short_summary: An East Green marketplace with evening access and multiple food concepts.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University lists Jefferson Marketplace in Jefferson Hall and publishes 2026–27 Monday–Thursday hours of 10:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Ohio University Culinary Services: Locations and Hours
cards.access_notes: Published 2026–27 marketplace hours: Monday–Thursday, 10:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.; Friday and weekend service ends at 9 p.m.

cards.title: Boyd Market
cards.subtitle: Boyd Hall, 100 West Green Drive • open until 9 p.m.
cards.notes: Use this West Green market for convenience merchandise or Smooth Moves; the university notes that non-meal-plan market items require Bobcat Cash or a card.
cards.short_summary: A Boyd Hall market with published nightly access through 9 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University lists Boyd Market in Boyd Hall at 100 West Green Drive and publishes 2026–27 hours of 8:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m. Monday–Friday.
cards.source_title: Ohio University Culinary Services: Locations and Hours
cards.access_notes: Published 2026–27 hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m.; Saturday–Sunday, noon–9:00 p.m.

cards.title: Nelson Market
cards.subtitle: Nelson Commons, 10 North McKinley Avenue • until 9 p.m.
cards.notes: Use the South Green market for convenience merchandise, local products, and Fresh Take products, keeping posted university break closures in mind.
cards.short_summary: A South Green market that maintains listed evening hours every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University lists Nelson Market at 10 North McKinley Avenue and publishes 2026–27 hours ending at 9:00 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Ohio University Culinary Services: Locations and Hours
cards.access_notes: Published 2026–27 hours: Monday–Friday, 10:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m.; Saturday–Sunday, noon–9:00 p.m.

cards.title: Latitude 39
cards.subtitle: Baker University Center • dinner until 9 p.m. Tuesday–Saturday
cards.notes: Make a dinner reservation or order ahead through OHIO Eats at the Baker Center restaurant; published dinner service runs Tuesday through Saturday evenings.
cards.short_summary: A sit-down Baker Center option with published dinner service until 9 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University locates Latitude 39 in Baker University Center and publishes 2026–27 dinner hours of 5:00–9:00 p.m. Tuesday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Ohio University Culinary Services: Locations and Hours
cards.access_notes: Published 2026–27 dinner hours: Tuesday–Saturday, 5:00–9:00 p.m.; closed Sunday and dinner is not listed Monday.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten current Ohio University places for studying, gathering, recreation, art, and campus events.

cards.title: College Green
cards.subtitle: Historic campus green
cards.notes: Bring a blanket or meet classmates before a campus program; check the university calendar for current events scheduled on the green.
cards.short_summary: A central outdoor setting for university gatherings and performances.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University lists College Green as the site of the 2026 Involvement Fair and describes the Under the Elms concert series there.
cards.source_title: Center for Student Engagement & Leadership | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor events and access vary by schedule and weather; consult the university calendar.

cards.title: Baker University Center Front Room
cards.subtitle: Baker University Center
cards.notes: Use the shared seating for a casual meet-up or a pause between classes; the stage may be reserved while the room remains open.
cards.short_summary: A public Baker Center room with seating and a reservable stage.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University states that the Front Room is open to the public even while events are taking place, with only its stage reservable.
cards.source_title: Baker University Center Event Spaces | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: The stage may be in use for a reservation; follow posted room and event guidance.

cards.title: Alden Library Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Alden Library, second floor
cards.notes: Choose this floor when your group needs computers, group rooms, or multimedia tools; use the library’s room-reservation process when needed.
cards.short_summary: An active, technology-rich setting for collaborative academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries identifies Alden's second-floor Learning Commons as an active, technology-rich study environment with group study rooms.
cards.source_title: Alden Library Floors | Ohio University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Study rooms and library services have their own availability and reservation rules.

cards.entity_name: Alden Library Very Quiet Study Area
cards.title: Alden Library Very Quiet Study Area
cards.subtitle: Alden Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Head here for focused individual work near the College Green entrance; keep conversation and audio low to match the designated setting.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet option within Alden's fourth-floor study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries lists a Very Quiet Study Area among the study spaces on Alden Library's fourth floor.
cards.source_title: Alden Library Floors | Ohio University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Observe library noise guidelines and check current building access before visiting.

cards.title: Alden Library Seventh Floor
cards.subtitle: Alden Library, top floor
cards.notes: Take a focused reading or writing session to the top floor, where tables and the quieter setting support longer independent work blocks.
cards.short_summary: A top-floor quiet-study space with campus-facing views.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries says Alden's seventh floor is a popular quiet-study space with views overlooking campus.
cards.source_title: Alden Library Floors | Ohio University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Observe library noise guidelines and check current building access before visiting.

cards.title: Charles J. Ping Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: 82 South Green Drive
cards.notes: Plan an active break around the climbing wall, courts, track, or fitness areas; bring a physical OHIO ID for activity-area entry.
cards.short_summary: A three-floor campus recreation facility with courts, track, climbing, and fitness space.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University describes the Ping Center as a three-floor recreation facility with a climbing wall, courts, track, weight areas, and fitness rooms.
cards.source_title: Charles J. Ping Recreation Center | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: A valid physical OHIO ID is required for activity areas; hours and membership eligibility vary.

cards.title: Well-Being Wing
cards.subtitle: Ping Recreation Center, second floor
cards.notes: Use the studio for small-group connection or reserve a room for an approved gathering; ask staff about current wellness-suite access.
cards.short_summary: A Ping Center wellness area supporting individual and small-group connection.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University says the Well-Being Wing includes a studio for small-group programming and one-on-one connections, plus reservable rooms.
cards.source_title: Well-Being Wing | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Located in Room 226 and nearby rooms on Ping's second floor; it follows Ping Center hours and reservation rules.

cards.title: Kennedy Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: Lin Hall, Ridges Green
cards.notes: Pair an exhibition visit with a walk around the Ridges; review gallery hours before leaving campus because the museum has seasonal schedules.
cards.short_summary: An academic art museum with exhibitions and collection-based learning.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University identifies the Kennedy Museum of Art as an academic museum offering exhibitions, programs, and learning opportunities for students and visitors.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Kennedy Museum of Art at OHIO
cards.access_notes: At 100 Ridges Circle in Lin Hall; verify seasonal gallery hours before visiting.

cards.title: Ridges Outdoor Museum
cards.subtitle: The Ridges trail system
cards.notes: Follow the outdoor learning route at your own pace and use the web-based tour materials to connect trail stops with campus research.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor learning experience built around Ridges trails and points of interest.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University describes the Outdoor Museum as an integrated outdoor learning experience across the Ridges trail network and regional points of interest.
cards.source_title: Outdoor Museum | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Use marked trails and appropriate footwear; conditions and tour materials may change seasonally.

cards.title: Hockhocking Adena Bikeway
cards.subtitle: University-maintained section along the Hocking River
cards.notes: Use the paved path for a walk, run, or ride, and note the painted mile markers when planning a turnaround or meeting point.
cards.short_summary: A paved river corridor that links Athens with nearby communities and recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University describes the Hockhocking Adena Bikeway as a 22-plus-mile paved path and says it stewards the segment between O'Bleness Hospital and Stimson Avenue.
cards.source_title: Sustainable Living Hub: Transportation | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Use normal path safety practices; consult local notices for weather, maintenance, or route conditions.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten current or recurring no-admission activities at Ohio University and in Athens, with direct-source access details.

cards.title: See printmaking experiments at Waves of Influence
cards.subtitle: Kennedy Museum of Art, Lin Hall
cards.notes: Walk through the exhibition’s prints by Hockney, Frankenthaler, Rauschenberg, Stella, and contemporaries; check museum hours before heading to The Ridges.
cards.short_summary: A free museum-gallery look at late-20th-century printmaking.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University lists Waves of Influence at Kennedy Museum of Art and states that admission is always free.
cards.source_title: Waves of Influence | Ohio University Calendar
cards.access_notes: Kennedy Museum of Art lists gallery hours and says admission is always free; donations are optional.

cards.title: Explore Material Matters
cards.subtitle: Kennedy Museum of Art, Lin Hall
cards.notes: Use the student-curated exhibition as a conversation starter about craftsmanship, materials, and community histories; pair it with another gallery during the same visit.
cards.short_summary: A student-curated exhibition running through March 2027.
cards.evidence_claim: Material Matters is a 2025–26 Museum Studies exhibition running April 10, 2026 through March 21, 2027; Kennedy Museum admission is always free.
cards.source_title: Material Matters | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Visit during Kennedy Museum gallery hours; the museum’s visit page states admission is always free.

cards.title: Make a slow lap through Kennedy Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: 100 Ridges Circle, The Ridges
cards.notes: Choose a few works or galleries to discuss instead of trying to see everything at once; museum admission is free and donations are optional.
cards.short_summary: A free art-museum visit in Lin Hall at The Ridges.
cards.evidence_claim: Kennedy Museum of Art in Lin Hall states that admission is always free.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Kennedy Museum of Art at OHIO
cards.access_notes: Summer 2026 hours are Thursday–Sunday, noon–5 p.m.; confirm hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Public Telescope Nights at the Ohio University Observatory
cards.title: Drop in for Public Telescope Night
cards.subtitle: Ohio University Observatory, The Ridges
cards.notes: Bring a friend for a faculty- and student-hosted sky watch; arrive during the listed drop-in window and check for weather-related cancellation updates.
cards.short_summary: Free public observing nights with campus astronomers.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University states that telescope nights at the Ohio University Observatory are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Public Telescope Nights at the Ohio University Observatory
cards.access_notes: Summer 2026 drop-in dates include August 21 and 22, 9–11 p.m.; events cancel for cloudy or stormy skies.

cards.title: Take a quiet reset in Alden’s Meditation Room
cards.subtitle: Fifth floor, Vernon R. Alden Library
cards.notes: Use the first-come room for silent meditation, prayer, or reflection; remove shoes if possible and leave food, conversation, and devices outside the moment.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet room for brief silent reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries says the Alden Library Meditation Room is open to students, staff, faculty, and visitors whenever the floor is open.
cards.source_title: Library Policies and Guidelines | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: First-come use only; the library asks visitors not to use it as a lounge, study room, or meeting room.

cards.title: Browse maps and public documents in Alden
cards.subtitle: Fifth floor, Vernon R. Alden Library
cards.notes: Pick a map or public document connected to a class, hometown, or travel idea and compare notes together; the collection is open to the public.
cards.short_summary: A public collection of government documents and maps.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University says Alden’s Government Documents and Maps collections are open to the public.
cards.source_title: Government Documents | Ohio University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on Alden Library’s fifth floor; use the library during its posted operating hours.

cards.title: Set up a no-cost reading or study hang at Alden
cards.subtitle: 30 Park Place, Ohio University
cards.notes: Meet before 10 p.m., choose a library floor that suits your group’s noise level, and bring your own reading or class materials for a low-key session.
cards.short_summary: Public daytime access to Ohio University’s main library.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries states that Alden Library is open to the public during operating hours before 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Library Hours and Building Access | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Public access is available before 10 p.m.; after 10 p.m., a valid Ohio University ID is required.

cards.title: Browse the Dairy Barn Holiday Bazaar
cards.subtitle: Dairy Barn Arts Center, 8000 Dairy Lane
cards.notes: Go with a friend to look at handmade work and meet participating artists; browsing and admission are free, while any purchases remain completely optional.
cards.short_summary: A December craft event with free entry.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dairy Barn lists its Holiday Bazaar as a yearly event and states that admission is free to attend.
cards.source_title: Craft Festivals | The Dairy Barn Arts Center
cards.access_notes: The listed 2026 Holiday Bazaar dates are December 11–12; entry is free, but vendors may offer items for purchase.

cards.title: Watch for a free Dairy Barn opening reception
cards.subtitle: Dairy Barn Arts Center, 8000 Dairy Lane
cards.notes: Check the Dairy Barn’s exhibition announcements, then go early to view new work and talk about what catches your attention; refreshments may be available.
cards.short_summary: Free public receptions for new Dairy Barn exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dairy Barn described its exhibition opening reception as free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Opening Reception | The Dairy Barn Arts Center
cards.access_notes: This source documents a free public reception; check the Dairy Barn’s current calendar for the next opening date.

cards.title: Attend a Kennedy Lecture Series talk
cards.subtitle: Ohio University Athens Campus
cards.notes: Check the series calendar for a speaker and bring a classmate to compare takeaways afterward; Ohio University describes every event as free and open to the public.
cards.short_summary: A campus lecture series open without admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University states that all Kennedy Lecture Series events are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Community Programs | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Confirm the specific event’s time, location, and any accessibility details through Ohio University’s calendar.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented study settings in and around Alden Library, spanning quiet reading, collaborative work, reservable rooms, and technology-enabled spaces.

cards.title: Alden Library First Floor
cards.subtitle: Quiet and silent study spaces, Alden Library
cards.notes: Set up among the international collections and microforms when you want a quieter reading session; use the floor map to locate group rooms 108–112.
cards.short_summary: A collection-side floor with both quiet and silent study options.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries says Alden’s first floor offers quiet and silent study spaces and lists Group Study Rooms 108–112.
cards.source_title: Alden Library Floors | University Libraries | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Check current library hours before visiting; late-night access is limited to current faculty, staff, and students with valid Ohio University ID.

cards.title: Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Alden Library
cards.notes: Choose this active, technology-rich setting for computer-based work or a group session; the second-floor map identifies several nearby group study rooms.
cards.short_summary: A technology-rich second-floor environment for individual or group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries describes the second-floor Learning Commons as an active, technology-rich study environment with several group study rooms.
cards.source_title: Alden Library Floors | University Libraries | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Check current library hours before visiting; late-night access is limited to current faculty, staff, and students with valid Ohio University ID.

cards.title: Hushpods
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Alden Library
cards.notes: Use the sound-dampening pods for a contained work session, then keep printers, scanners, charging, and the service desk within the same floor.
cards.short_summary: Sound-dampening pods inside Alden’s second-floor study environment.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries lists Hushpods, identified as sound-dampening study pods, on Alden Library’s second floor.
cards.source_title: Alden Library Floors | University Libraries | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Check current library hours before visiting; late-night access is limited to current faculty, staff, and students with valid Ohio University ID.

cards.title: CoLab
cards.subtitle: Third floor, Alden Library
cards.notes: Bring a project that benefits from making or collaboration: this alternative work space includes a makerspace, 3D-printing lab, and reservable conference/study rooms.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor alternative work space with making tools and reservable rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University identifies CoLab as an alternative study and working space on Alden’s third floor with a makerspace, 3D-printing lab, and reservable rooms.
cards.source_title: CoLab | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: CoLab posts its own operating hours and follows Alden Library hours and closures; check the current schedule before going.

cards.title: Alden Library Third Floor
cards.subtitle: Quiet and group study settings, Alden Library
cards.notes: Pick this floor when your work may shift between solo focus and group discussion; its map also identifies computers, scanners, and instructional labs.
cards.short_summary: A flexible floor combining quiet work, group work, computers, and study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries says Alden’s third floor mixes quiet and group study environments, group study rooms, instructional labs, and computers.
cards.source_title: Alden Library Floors | University Libraries | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Check current library hours before visiting; late-night access is limited to current faculty, staff, and students with valid Ohio University ID.

cards.title: Class of 1951 Lounge
cards.subtitle: Fourth floor, Alden Library
cards.notes: Use the lounge as an open study option when it is not hosting a library or campus event; confirm the day’s room schedule if you need a dependable seat.
cards.short_summary: A fourth-floor lounge that can also host library and campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries lists the Class of 1951 Lounge on Alden’s fourth floor and notes that library and campus events are often held there.
cards.source_title: Alden Library Floors | University Libraries | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Event use may affect availability; check current library hours and the room schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Very Quiet Study Area
cards.subtitle: Fourth floor, Alden Library
cards.notes: Head here for low-distraction individual work, with the fourth-floor help desk, lockers, printers, and Group Study Room 401B also on the floor.
cards.short_summary: A designated very-quiet fourth-floor setting with nearby study support services.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries lists a Very Quiet Study Area, Group Study Room 401B, lockers, printers, and a help desk on Alden’s fourth floor.
cards.source_title: Alden Library Floors | University Libraries | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Check current library hours before visiting; late-night access is limited to current faculty, staff, and students with valid Ohio University ID.

cards.title: Alden Library Fifth Floor
cards.subtitle: Quiet study near archives and maps
cards.notes: Settle in on this quiet floor when you want to work near Government Documents, Maps, the archives, or the Ryan Room; keep your voice low.
cards.short_summary: A quiet study floor alongside government documents, maps, and archives.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries identifies Alden’s fifth floor as a quiet study space and lists Government Documents and Maps, the archives, and the Ryan Room.
cards.source_title: Alden Library Floors | University Libraries | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Check current library hours before visiting; late-night access is limited to current faculty, staff, and students with valid Ohio University ID.

cards.title: Alden Library Sixth Floor
cards.subtitle: Book stacks and campus overlook
cards.notes: Use a spot among the A–LT stacks for quiet work with a campus view; plan research pulls around the call-number ranges housed on this floor.
cards.short_summary: A quiet sixth-floor stacks setting with a campus view.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries calls Alden’s sixth floor a popular place for quiet study that overlooks campus and says it holds call numbers A–LT.
cards.source_title: Alden Library Floors | University Libraries | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Check current library hours before visiting; late-night access is limited to current faculty, staff, and students with valid Ohio University ID.

cards.title: Alden Library Seventh Floor
cards.subtitle: Top-floor quiet study, Alden Library
cards.notes: Take a table on the top floor for a quiet study session with campus views, and use the nearby P–ZA stacks or Children’s Collection for research breaks.
cards.short_summary: A quiet top-floor setting with campus views and book stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries describes Alden’s top floor as a popular place for quiet study with views overlooking campus and lists call numbers P–ZA.
cards.source_title: Alden Library Floors | University Libraries | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Check current library hours before visiting; late-night access is limited to current faculty, staff, and students with valid Ohio University ID.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten distinct named destinations on Athens corridors immediately beyond Ohio University’s campus.

cards.title: Athena Cinema
cards.subtitle: South Court Street corridor
cards.notes: Check the current showtime schedule, then photograph the 20 South Court marquee before heading inside for an evening screening.
cards.short_summary: A Court Street cinema with daily-changing showtimes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Athena Cinema is at 20 S. Court St.; Ohio University identifies it as a commercial movie theater in the evenings.
cards.source_title: Athena Cinema | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Current showtimes and ticket details are posted by the cinema.

cards.title: Athens County Courthouse
cards.subtitle: South Court Street corridor
cards.notes: Pause at the courthouse clock and red-brick façade at Court and Washington, then continue along the Uptown sidewalks.
cards.short_summary: A working 1880 courthouse at the foot of Court Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ohio Supreme Court says the Athens County Courthouse was built in 1880 and sits at 1 South Court Street.
cards.source_title: Ohio Courthouses | Supreme Court of Ohio
cards.access_notes: This is an active government building; follow posted entry and security rules.

cards.title: Bagel Street Deli
cards.subtitle: South Court Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the 27 South Court Street location as a lunch stop and choose from the shop’s bagelwich menu before walking onward.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated bagel-sandwich stop on South Court.
cards.evidence_claim: Bagel Street Deli’s official site lists its Athens location at 27 S. Court Street.
cards.source_title: Bagel Street Deli
cards.access_notes: Food purchases are required; confirm current service details with the business.

cards.title: Court Street Coffee
cards.subtitle: South Court Street corridor
cards.notes: Meet at the Uptown café at 67 South Court Street and use its posted daytime hours to plan a coffee or study break.
cards.short_summary: A café with a clearly listed Uptown location and hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Court Street Coffee lists its Uptown café at 67 South Court Street and publishes its current weekly hours.
cards.source_title: Court Street Coffee
cards.access_notes: The business lists Uptown hours as weekdays 7 a.m.–6 p.m. and weekends 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; verify before visiting.

cards.title: Fluff Bakery
cards.subtitle: North Court Street corridor
cards.notes: Stop at 8 North Court Street for the bakery case or brunch menu, and check the posted schedule before making the walk.
cards.short_summary: A North Court bakery serving pastries, breakfast, lunch, and brunch.
cards.evidence_claim: Fluff Bakery lists its address as 8 N. Court Street and says it serves fresh pastries, breakfast, lunch, and brunch.
cards.source_title: Fluff Bakery | Athens, Ohio
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are Tuesday–Friday 8:30 a.m.–3 p.m. and Saturday–Sunday 9 a.m.–3 p.m.; closed Monday.

cards.title: Donkey Coffee and Espresso
cards.subtitle: West Washington Street corridor, one block from Court Street
cards.notes: Walk one block west from Court Street to the 17½ West Washington address for coffee, pastries, art, and free Wi‑Fi.
cards.short_summary: A Washington Street coffee shop with several rooms and free Wi‑Fi.
cards.evidence_claim: Donkey Coffee lists its location at 17½ W. Washington Street and describes 150 seats, six rooms, art, music, and free wireless access.
cards.source_title: Donkey Coffee and Espresso
cards.access_notes: The business posts hours through midnight daily; purchases are available on site.

cards.title: Passion Works Studio
cards.subtitle: East State Street corridor, beside the Court Street intersection
cards.notes: Visit the 20 East State Street studio to see collaborative artwork, browse the gallery, or ask about volunteering opportunities.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative arts studio just off the Court Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Passion Works Studio lists its studio at 20 East State Street and invites visitors and volunteers.
cards.source_title: Visit | Passion Works Studio
cards.access_notes: The studio lists visitor hours Monday–Saturday 10 a.m.–6 p.m. and Sunday 10 a.m.–4 p.m.

cards.title: Casa Nueva Restaurant & Cantina
cards.subtitle: West State Street corridor, beside the Court Street intersection
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s 6 West State Street carryout or dine-in service for a meal, and check its posted weekly schedule first.
cards.short_summary: A State Street restaurant offering food, music, and art programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Casa Nueva lists its address as 6 W. State Street and says it serves local food, music, and art in Appalachian Ohio.
cards.source_title: Casa Nueva Restaurant & Cantina Contact
cards.access_notes: Dine-in and carryout hours are posted as 9 a.m.–9 p.m. Monday and Wednesday–Sunday; closed Tuesday.

cards.title: Athens Public Library
cards.subtitle: Home Street corridor, just north of Court Street
cards.notes: Head to 30 Home Street for public computers, Wi‑Fi, meeting rooms, bike checkouts, or the ongoing used-book sale.
cards.short_summary: A public library branch with workspaces, Wi‑Fi, and community programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Athens County Public Libraries lists the Athens branch at 30 Home Street with Wi‑Fi, public computers, meeting rooms, and bike checkouts.
cards.source_title: Athens Public Library | Athens County Public Libraries
cards.access_notes: The branch lists Monday–Thursday hours of 9 a.m.–8 p.m. and Friday–Saturday hours of 9 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Village Bakery and Café
cards.subtitle: East State Street corridor
cards.notes: Continue east on State Street to 268 East State for breads, pastries, sandwiches, soups, and daily plates made around local ingredients.
cards.short_summary: An East State bakery-café with breads, pastries, and savory food.
cards.evidence_claim: Village Bakery and Café lists its address at 268 East State Street and describes breads, pastries, sandwiches, soups, and daily plates.
cards.source_title: Village Bakery and Café
cards.access_notes: The café posts Tuesday–Friday 8 a.m.–6 p.m., Saturday 8 a.m.–3 p.m., and Sunday brunch 9 a.m.–2 p.m.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Ohio University rituals and recurring campus practices, from the first-year procession to Marching 110 standards.

cards.title: Enter as a new student; depart after commencement
cards.subtitle: Alumni Gateway, College Green
cards.notes: Walk toward campus through Alumni Gateway when you arrive, then make the return passage away from campus after commencement.
cards.short_summary: A bookend ritual at the gateway gifted by the Class of 1915.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University identifies walking toward campus as a new student and away from campus after commencement as an Alumni Gateway tradition.
cards.source_title: History and Traditions | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor gateway; observe the route during campus visits or commencement activities.

cards.title: Come back for the uptown parade
cards.subtitle: Athens Campus and uptown Athens
cards.notes: Look for the annual Homecoming week schedule, then watch the uptown parade and campus celebrations alongside returning Bobcats.
cards.short_summary: A decades-old reunion week built around alumni returning to Athens.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University describes Homecoming as a decades-old annual tradition with an uptown parade, football game, performances, pep rallies, contests and court.
cards.source_title: History and Traditions | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Annual event; consult the university’s current Homecoming information before planning.

cards.title: Learn “Alma Mater, Ohio”
cards.subtitle: Ohio University ceremonial and musical tradition
cards.notes: Read or listen to the university’s alma mater before a ceremony or performance, and recognize its 1915 creation in campus history.
cards.short_summary: Ohio University’s alma mater dates to 1915.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University states that its alma mater, “Alma Mater, Ohio,” was created in 1915.
cards.source_title: History and Traditions | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Listen through official Marching 110 recordings or attend an appropriate university ceremony.

cards.title: Join the fight-song refrain
cards.subtitle: Ohio University athletic tradition
cards.notes: Listen for “Stand Up and Cheer!” at an Ohio athletics event and follow the song as part of the shared game-day program.
cards.short_summary: The school fight song has been sung at athletics since the early 1900s.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University says “Stand Up and Cheer” has been sung as an athletic song since the early 1900s.
cards.source_title: History and Traditions | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Athletic-event access and admission vary by event; official audio is also available online.

cards.title: Spot the Cutler Hall-inspired mace
cards.subtitle: Official university ceremonies
cards.notes: At a formal university ceremony, look for the bronze mace carried and displayed as part of the official proceedings.
cards.short_summary: A bronze mace modeled on an original Cutler Hall stair railing.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University says its ceremonial mace is modeled on an original Cutler Hall stair railing and is carried and displayed at official ceremonies.
cards.source_title: History and Traditions | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: View it only during official ceremonies where it is included; do not handle ceremonial objects.

cards.title: Watch the band dance “Ain’t Been Good”
cards.subtitle: Marching 110 performance standard
cards.notes: See a Marching 110 performance or official recording to catch the ensemble dance routine performed throughout the song.
cards.short_summary: A 1968 song-and-dance standard that the 110 still performs.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University states that David Fowler began the “Ain’t Been Good” dance tradition and that the Marching 110 still performs it.
cards.source_title: History of the Marching 110 | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Performance schedules vary; the university provides official audio and background for this standard.

cards.title: Follow the 110 to the Ohio Theatre
cards.subtitle: Annual Marching 110 concert, Columbus
cards.notes: Watch for the Marching 110’s annual Ohio Theatre appearance and use the band’s official channels for current performance details.
cards.short_summary: The band has maintained an annual Ohio Theatre performance tradition since 1974.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University’s Marching 110 history says the band began its annual tradition of performing at the Ohio Theatre in Columbus in 1974.
cards.source_title: History of the Marching 110 | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Off-campus Columbus performance; ticketing and access vary by the announced event.

cards.title: Follow the Marching 110 through Alumni Gateway
cards.subtitle: Richland Avenue to College Green
cards.notes: After First-Year Student Convocation, join the Marching 110-led walk up Richland Avenue and through Alumni Gateway to the Involvement Fair.
cards.short_summary: A Welcome Week procession connecting new students with College Green.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University describes the Marching 110 leading first-year students after Convocation up Richland Avenue, through Alumni Gateway, to the Involvement Fair.
cards.source_title: Welcome Week ’24: Let’s get it started | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Part of fall Welcome Week for new students; follow current university event instructions.

cards.title: Form the letters O-H-I-O on the field
cards.subtitle: Frank Solich Field at Peden Stadium
cards.notes: Take part in the first-year class photo during Welcome Week, when the entering class forms O-H-I-O on the football field.
cards.short_summary: A Welcome Week class portrait made by arranging students into the university name.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University calls the first-year student photo on Frank Solich Field an iconic Welcome Week experience and depicts students forming O-H-I-O.
cards.source_title: Welcome Week ’24: Let’s get it started | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Scheduled during Welcome Week for entering students; participation details change by year.

cards.title: Read the plaque at the Kissing Circle
cards.subtitle: College Green historic tradition
cards.notes: Visit the plaque on College Green and learn how the marked circle became associated with kissing and later with painted messages.
cards.short_summary: A College Green tradition whose painted-circle history is documented by University Libraries.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries documents the Kissing Circle tradition, including its former white X, kissing rule, and later fraternity and sorority painting activity.
cards.source_title: 2019 Homecoming Display Provided an Exciting Look at OHIO’s Past | Ohio University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Treat this as a historic site and expression space; do not paint or alter campus surfaces without authorization.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Ohio University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe sequence for getting oriented on campus, finding an activity, and seeing a little of Athens.

cards.title: Start with a College Green walk
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Historic campus center
cards.notes: Use the Green as your first landmark: walk its paths, spot nearby academic buildings, and choose a return route to your residence hall.
cards.short_summary: A simple first orientation loop through the historic campus core.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University identifies College Green as a featured stop on its campus tours and describes it as historic.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; follow posted campus guidance.

cards.title: Get your bearings at Baker
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Student-life hub
cards.notes: Stop at the information desk, locate the Center for Student Engagement & Leadership, and note the gallery, theatre, and meeting spaces for later.
cards.short_summary: A practical indoor stop for services, spaces, and campus-life information.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University calls Baker University Center the hub of student life and lists its information desk, theatre, galleries, and student-engagement office.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Public-facing building spaces and services vary by room and event.

cards.title: Choose one official weekend event
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Check the Athens listings
cards.notes: Open the official calendar, filter for Athens and your dates, then select one event with clear attendance details before you head out.
cards.short_summary: Use the university’s central calendar to make a specific plan.
cards.evidence_claim: The Calendar of University Events is Ohio University’s central calendar for official university and student-organization events.
cards.source_title: Calendar of University Events (CUE) | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Confirm the individual event’s time, location, audience, and any ticket or registration requirement.

cards.title: Make Alden your reset point
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · 30 Park Place
cards.notes: Find the second-floor service desk and self-pickup shelf, then pick a floor that suits a quiet pause, reading, or planning session.
cards.short_summary: An academic anchor for a calm break and practical library orientation.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University Libraries lists Alden Library at 30 Park Place and describes second-floor pickup and service-desk locations.
cards.source_title: Borrowing Books & Materials | Ohio University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Check current hours; late-night access is limited to current faculty, staff, and students with valid Ohio University ID.

cards.entity_name: Charles J. Ping Student Recreation Center
cards.title: Locate Ping for weekend recreation
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · 82 South Green Drive
cards.notes: Walk by the recreation center, review its program offerings, and save the facility location for a future class, club, or intramural activity.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation stop with multiple ways to participate later.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University lists the Charles J. Ping Recreation Center among Campus Recreation facilities; the university calendar gives its address as 82 South Green Drive.
cards.source_title: Well-Being and Recreation | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Facility entry and program participation may have separate eligibility or reservation requirements.

cards.title: Browse the Saturday market
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Athens Community Center
cards.notes: Take a short off-campus outing to browse the market at your own pace; bring a reusable bag only if you plan to purchase something.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled Saturday-morning visit beyond the campus boundary.
cards.evidence_claim: Athens Farmers Market states that it operates Saturdays year-round from 9 a.m. to noon at the Athens Community Center, 701 East State Street.
cards.source_title: Athens Farmers Market
cards.access_notes: Verify conditions before traveling; purchases are optional and sold by individual vendors.

cards.title: Ride the Purple Loop to connect the core
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Baker, College Green, South/East Green
cards.notes: Use the loop for a campus-scale orientation ride, then get off at a stop you have not yet explored and walk back deliberately.
cards.short_summary: A free campus transit loop linking central and green-space stops.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University says the Purple Loop serves Baker University Center, College Green, and South/East Green; CATS daily campus shuttles are free and need no pass or ID.
cards.source_title: CATS Daily Campus Shuttles | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Runs Monday–Friday, 7:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m. during fall and spring semesters; it does not run during breaks, holidays, or summer.

cards.title: Take a daylight walk at The Ridges
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Public trails and walkways
cards.notes: Choose a marked trail or walkway, check conditions, bring water, and keep the outing to daylight while you learn the area’s layout.
cards.short_summary: A daylight outdoor detour on Ohio University’s Athens campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University states that several hiking trails and walkways at The Ridges are available for public use, including Radar Hill.
cards.source_title: Visit The Ridges | Athens | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Use marked public trails and walkways; review the Ridges trail map and current conditions before leaving.

cards.title: Check for a public telescope night
cards.subtitle: Saturday night · The Ridges
cards.notes: If the calendar lists a clear-weather telescope night, arrive during the posted drop-in window and follow the parking and walking directions from the observatory.
cards.short_summary: A weather-dependent evening science activity at The Ridges.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University says telescope nights at the Ohio University Observatory are free and open to the public, with viewing dependent on sky conditions.
cards.source_title: Public Telescope Nights at the Ohio University Observatory
cards.access_notes: Attend only on a posted telescope-night date; events are canceled when skies are cloudy or stormy.

cards.title: End by finding one way to get involved
cards.subtitle: Sunday · 330 Baker University Center
cards.notes: Browse Bobcat Connect or speak with staff about one student organization, program, or upcoming event that fits something you already enjoy.
cards.short_summary: A closing step that turns the weekend into one manageable next connection.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio University’s Center for Student Engagement & Leadership supports student organizations and campus programming and directs students to Bobcat Connect for organizations and student-run events.
cards.source_title: Center for Student Engagement & Leadership | Ohio University
cards.access_notes: Located at 330 Baker University Center; verify staff availability and individual event requirements.
